title: Common
description: Shared definitions for all WPI schemas: identifiers, time, market, language, money, canonical vocabulary enums, workflow states and the lineage object. This file is a definitions library; validate records against their own schemas, not against this root. Reference as 'common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>'.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC (ends with Z).

date_range.description: Inclusive ISO 8601 date range. Consumers must check start <= end; state the timezone on the owning record.

month_range.description: Month range 'YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM' (02-DETAILED-SPECIFICATION §7 writes 'YYYY-MM to YYYY-MM'; both separators accepted; ASSUMPTION: importers store the '/' form).

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in upper case, or 'global'.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag (simplified: language, optional script, optional region, optional variants). Examples: ar, ar-SA, en, en-GB, zxx.

decimal_amount.description: Non-negative decimal as a string. No floats for money.

money.description: Money as a decimal string plus ISO 4217 currency. Display KWD, JOD and BHD with 3 decimals and SAR, AED and QAR with 2; display rounding happens only at the presentation boundary.

content_hash.description: Content hash. ASSUMPTION: SHA-256, lower-case hex, 'sha256:' prefix.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL. Keep the original encoding (Arabic paths stay as found). ASSUMPTION: provisional limit chosen for v0.1.0; calibrate at M0B.

storage_uri.description: Cloud Storage object URI. Never a signed or public URL.

label.description: Short text. ASSUMPTION: provisional limit chosen for v0.1.0; calibrate at M0B.

text.description: Paragraph-length text. ASSUMPTION: provisional limit chosen for v0.1.0; calibrate at M0B.

long_text.description: Long text. ASSUMPTION: provisional limit chosen for v0.1.0; calibrate at M0B.

document_body.description: Document body such as an article draft. ASSUMPTION: provisional limit chosen for v0.1.0; calibrate at M0B.

rule_id.description: Rule identifier such as CRW-001, SEO-011, I18N-002, A11Y-001, SPAM-001 (v1-baseline §7; 02-DETAILED-SPECIFICATION §6).

semver.description: Semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release suffix (for example 0.1.0-draft).

methodology_version.description: Version of the rule set, scoring method or rubric that produced the value.

config_key.description: Key into a versioned config file (for example a provider, engine or connector entry). Never a hard-coded model ID, price or quota (D-010).

method_id.description: snake_case name of the capture or computation method, for example raw_http_fetch, rendered_fetch, gsc_search_analytics, csv_import, rules_engine, rubric_assessment.

message_key.description: Dotted key into the Arabic and English message catalogs.

uuid_list.description: List of UUIDs. ASSUMPTION: provisional limit chosen for v0.1.0; calibrate at M0B.

evidence_ids.description: EvidenceObject IDs that support the record. ASSUMPTION: provisional limit chosen for v0.1.0; calibrate at M0B.

url_list.description: List of URLs. ASSUMPTION: provisional limit chosen for v0.1.0; calibrate at M0B.

checked_of.description: 'checked X of Y' disclosure shown beside every score and rate. Consumers must check checked <= of.

quoted_span.description: A short quote from an evidence object.

text.description: Quoted span, at most 25 words (runtime AUDITOR instruction).

fidelity_label.description: How a value was obtained (03-PRODUCTION-CONTRACTS: Evidence and fidelity).

integrity_state.description: Input integrity state. Kept separate from the fidelity label (03-PRODUCTION-CONTRACTS).

evidence_state.description: User-facing report tag. Mapping: observed/computed -> verified; assessed -> inferred; attested/user_supplied -> client_stated; estimated -> estimated; unavailable -> unavailable; a check that could not complete -> not_verified. The original fidelity label is never erased.

rule_result.description: Rule result. Score values: pass 1.00, partial 0.50, fail 0.00. not_applicable leaves the denominator; unavailable and error leave the score and lower confidence (v1-baseline §6.3).

source_tier.description: External source grade: 1 primary documentation or open standard; 2 independent study with method; 3 vendor claim, usable only as a hypothesis.

risk_tier.description: Change risk tier (03-PRODUCTION-CONTRACTS: Change risk baseline). 'forbidden' changes are never approved or applied.

rule_category.description: Presence Readiness category. Weights (v1-baseline §6.2): crawlability 20, on_page 15, structured_data 10, aeo 20, geo 15, i18n_accessibility 10, performance_security 10.

experience_category.description: Experience Effectiveness category (04-CLAUDE-CODE-BUILD-PROMPT §7.2). Never blended into Presence Readiness (D-012). ASSUMPTION: value names.

confidence_level.description: Evidence confidence (v1-baseline §6.5). Not a statistical probability.

severity.description: Finding severity. Critical, High, Medium, Low from v1-baseline §6.6; 'info' is an ASSUMPTION for unscored observations.

access_class.description: Whether the subject belongs to an anonymous visitor or a registered user (D-002, D-004).

actor_type.description: Who performed an action. Only 'connector' may write to a client site. ASSUMPTION: value list.

evaluation_method.description: How a rule or finding was evaluated (04-CLAUDE-CODE-BUILD-PROMPT Appendix B: Finding.method).

source_type.description: Kind of source that produced a value. ASSUMPTION: value list; extend additively.

owner_type.description: Who implements a plan item (runtime PLANNER instruction).

apply_mode.description: How a plan item can be applied (02-DETAILED-SPECIFICATION §8).

prompt_family.description: Prompt family. Union of 04-CLAUDE-CODE-BUILD-PROMPT §10, the free-audit groups and the panel categories in 02-DETAILED-SPECIFICATION §6; consolidate at M6 (open item).

match_confidence.description: Entity match basis (v1-baseline §8.5). fuzzy_candidate never confirms a mention.

report_projection.description: Projection of the canonical report model. Anonymous users get web_interactive only (D-002).

tone.description: Presentation tone. Tone never changes facts, scores, severity or priority.

error_class.description: Failure classification for stages, attempts and runs. ASSUMPTION: value list.

audit_state.description: Audit workflow state (03-PRODUCTION-CONTRACTS: Workflow states). The five connected-analysis states apply to registered audits with connected sources only. See docs/state-machines.md.

connected_analysis_state.description: States that connected analysis may add to an audit (03-PRODUCTION-CONTRACTS).

anonymous_access_state.description: Anonymous report lifecycle state. ASSUMPTION: designed in docs/state-machines.md from D-002 and D-004.

prompt_panel_run_state.description: Prompt-panel run state. ASSUMPTION: designed in docs/state-machines.md from 05-PROJECT-PLAN §10.

deletion_request_state.description: Deletion request state. ASSUMPTION: designed in docs/state-machines.md.

export_authorization_state.description: Export authorization state. ASSUMPTION: designed in docs/state-machines.md.

lineage.description: V4 evidence and lineage fields. Every value that reaches a report, score, plan or change carries them (03-PRODUCTION-CONTRACTS: Evidence and fidelity).

record_id.description: ID of the record this lineage describes.

project_id.description: Owning project. Null for an anonymous audit until it is claimed (D-004).

site_id.description: Owning site. Null for an anonymous audit until it is claimed (D-004).

source_id.description: Identifier of the source instance: crawl run, upload ID, provider config key, connector ID, or rule ID.

source_version.description: Version of the source: API version, crawler version, export format version, or rule-set version.

captured_at.description: When the system captured or computed the value (RFC 3339 UTC).

as_of.description: The time the value describes. For period data, the end of the period.

language.description: BCP 47 tag. Use 'zxx' for values with no linguistic content.

content_hash.description: Hash of the evidence content, or of the canonical inputs for computed values.

parent_ids.description: Record IDs this value was derived from. Empty for primary observations.

audit_id.description: Audit that produced the value, when there is one.

module.description: Capability-gated product module. ASSUMPTION: value list derived from 01-PRODUCT-REQUIREMENTS §5 and §15-§17.

field_class.description: Class of a changed field. The tier floor for robots, canonical, redirect, hreflang, sitemap, slug, template, theme and site-wide classes is 3 (03-PRODUCTION-CONTRACTS: Change risk baseline). Exact tiers are versioned policy in config.

plan_risk_tier.description: Risk tier for planned or approved work. Forbidden tactics are never planned.

x-migration: additive optional fields bump minor; removals, renames or type changes bump major and need a migration note in docs/decisions.md
